description: A test script for verifying compatibility of object formats in git repositories, involving creation, signing, tagging, and comparison of git objects with different hash functions (sha1 and sha256).

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Returns the alternative hash function ('sha256' if input is 'sha1', and vice versa).

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'hello' based on the hash function.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'tree' based on the hash function.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit' based on the hash function.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit2' based on the hash function.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a commit object based on the specified hash function.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a tag object based on storage and hash function.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Compares git object IDs and properties between sha1 and sha256 repositories for consistency.
